name: EContact
welcome: Welcome to **EContact**, contacts for the Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon, like the Mac's Contacts: iCloud and other CardDAV address books, or contacts kept on the Atari alone. EMail and ECal find the people in it.

window.title: The window
items: Address books and [[Groups]]: what the list shows.
The contacts in it, A to Z.
The card chosen. Edit changes it: see [[Changing a card]].
Search: finds a contact as you type.

diagram.title: How EContact reaches your address books
diagram.round: [[Falcon mode|Accounts]]: the Falcon or TT does TLS itself
after: iCloud and most servers want an encrypted connection. A Raspberry Pi on your network can do it for any Atari, or a Falcon or TT can do it itself (ECONTACT.ACC and .PRG). Contacts kept on the Atari alone need neither. See [[Accounts]].
